theorems.name: Submission.eilenberg_compact_fiber_measurable
theorems.statement: ∀ (X : Type) [MetricSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X] (m : ℕ) (k : ℝ) (Q : Set X) (f : X → Rn m), 0 < k → IsCompact Q → ContinuousOn f Q → Measurable (fun y ↦ Chapter01.simonHausdorffMeasureReal k (Q ∩ f ⁻¹' {y}))
